raw.body:
React DevTools Store walks operations array and can throw an uncaught error:
`Cannot reorder children for node "[ID]" because no matching node was found in the Store.`

This desync occurs when elements are filtered or unmounted, but a reorder operation for their children is still processed. Throwing an uncaught error in the bridge listener crashes the entire DevTools extension panel, rendering it unusable.

This change modifies `TREE_OPERATION_REORDER_CHILDREN` and `SUSPENSE_TREE_OPERATION_REORDER_CHILDREN` cases in `packages/react-devtools-shared/src/devtools/store.js` to gracefully skip the reordering operation (by advancing the pointer past the child IDs) instead of throwing an error.

## How did you test this change?

Verified that it does not crash when receiving operations for missing/filtered nodes in desynced states.
Ran DevTools Jest test suite:
- `yarn test store-test`
raw.title: [DevTools] Gracefully handle missing nodes during child reorders
